summary: Examples of assemble: combining a fragments directory, adding a delimiter between fragments, and assembling sshd_config with validation through sshd -t.
questions: How do I assemble sshd_config from conf.d pieces and validate it?
How do I add a marker line between each fragment?

answer_card.title: assemble examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.assemble:
    src: /etc/someapp/fragments
    dest: /etc/someapp/someapp.conf
    delimiter: '### START FRAGMENT ###'

- ansible.builtin.assemble:
    src: /etc/ssh/conf.d/
    dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
    validate: /usr/sbin/sshd -t -f %s
```
